grains.RAW.PROGRAMS: one row per fictional BPO client program (city, channel, risk tier)
grains.RAW.PROGRAM_DAILY: one row per program per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.CONTROL_DOCUMENTS: one row per program (client document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.breach_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(SLA-breach incident at the program in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day incident-volume FORECAST across all programs; abandon-rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.INCIDENT_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic incident-handling SOPs (one per channel and incident type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.SLA_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.SLA_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, program, incident-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (programs, daily incidents, SLA breaches by program, SLA-breach risk, contact events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_CONTACTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_INCIDENT_ALERT logs new INCIDENT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
